description_en: Validates the syntax of HashiCorp Configuration Language (HCL) for Terraform
description_zh: 验证 Terraform 的 HCL 语法
name: ApiMcpServerValidateHcl

parameters.help_en: The content of the Terraform HCL code. For more information, see HCL language overview (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/terraform/terraform-configuration-and-hcl-language-overview)
parameters.help_zh: Terraform HCL 代码内容。HCL 语言概述 (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/terraform/terraform-configuration-and-hcl-language-overview)
parameters.name: code

diagnosticReport.description_en: The diagnostic report of the code
diagnosticReport.example: Argument or block definition required: An argument or block definition is required here.

items.description_en: The content of the error message
items.example: Unclosed configuration block: There is no closing brace for this block before the end of the file. This may be caused by incorrect brace nesting elsewhere in this file.

hash.description_en: The unique identifier of the Terraform HCL code
hash.description_zh: Terraform HCL 代码的唯一标识

isValid.description_en: Indicates whether the code is valid

items.example:
{
      "schema": {
        "writeOnly": false,
        "nullable": false,
        "description": "要修改的VPC名称。\n\n名称长度为1～128个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头。",
        "readOnly": false,
        "type": "string",
        "required": false
      },
      "deprecated": false,
      "allowEmptyValue": false,
      "name": "name",
      "required": false,
      "example": "terraform-example"
    }

items.description_en: The content of the warning message
